gen-gf-baloo-2-mulish: Mulish reads smooth and friendly, its strokes uniform and its apertures gaping like a horseshoe magnet. Baloo 2 is the one to make a statement with its breathing counters, and Mulish simply carries the sentences.
gen-gf-baloo-2-poppins: Poppins reads like lines from a technical pen, with loose rounded curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase body beneath the rounded heading. Baloo 2 supplies the expression.
gen-gf-baloo-2-rubik: Baloo 2 fills its lines with bowls that spill into the white space, giving it an expressive, distinctive voice up top. Rubik follows with a soft lowercase that looks large beside its capitals and stays clear at small sizes.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-bitter: Bitter reads dependable and grounded, its very large lowercase eye and see-through s giving the slab-serif lines a sturdy footing. And Baloo Bhai 2 is the louder one, its wide-mouthed rounds stretching toward the top line.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans keeps its strokes pipe-cleaner thin and uniform. Baloo Bhai 2 is the one with presence, its wide-mouthed lowercase rounds reaching high, while the sans simply lays down clean, modern lines with c ends pointing apart.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-inter: Inter hums through a paragraph like a smooth tube, its counters opened wide in a tall lowercase. Inter's featureless softness is the pair's strongest quality, a quiet floor under the heavy rounds of Baloo Bhai 2.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-mulish: Round, wide-mouthed lowercase stretches toward the top line. Mulish follows with no swelling or thinning at all, like cable bent into shapes, and that smooth uniformity set against the heading's commanding rounds is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-poppins: Big, round, loud. Poppins follows with strokes like a bent paperclip, and that gap between Baloo Bhai 2's commanding rounds and its smooth, tall-bodied lowercase is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-roboto-slab: Rounded, tall and commanding up top. Roboto Slab gives the pair its strongest quality, a precise, structured slab-serif texture where the middle zone dominates and open throats keep Baloo Bhai 2's weight in check.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-rubik: Rubik reads clean and soft, its lowercase looking large beside the capitals and its round letters staying open at small sizes. Over many lines Rubik would feel gentle and steady, a quiet follow-up to Baloo Bhai 2.
